title: Petra and the Spire
author: Xanthe Halloran
blurb: Felix Villalobos, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
